snippet.title: Only 3 People 🎣 Riddle #8 Answer + Riddle #9: The Clock Tower Trap 🕰️ #shorts
snippet.description:
Yesterday's answer: there were only three people fishing: a grandfather, his son and his grandson. The man in the middle is a father and a son at the same time. Two fathers, two sons, three people, three fish.

Riddle #9: An old clock tower strikes six times in exactly five seconds. Person 1 stands below and counts every strike. Each strike is instant, and the gaps between them are always equal. So how long does it take to strike twelve times? Careful: it is not ten seconds.

Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise. 🌅

#riddle #brainteaser #logicpuzzle #puzzle #shorts
